pairing_rule: Use matched baseline/candidate assigned workloads with equal verification/risk and precommitted eligible-wake, exposure/censoring and admission/defer/timeout policies. Randomize AB/BA or crossover from the same sealed starting snapshot, reset candidate-sensitive runtime state between arms, preserve external monotonic audit state, and report intention-to-treat coverage plus order/carryover interaction.

denominator_integrity.rule: Both arms must use the same authoritative Experience/operational classification, accepted-receipt semantics, malformed-record handling, N/R terminal-state semantics, authority/freshness provenance, verification-stage binding and replay-resistant evidence lineage. Candidate-only self-test timing is observational and cannot establish a speed multiplier.
denominator_integrity.reject: No positive speed claim from awake/window/commit/heartbeat/poll/retry proxies, caller-minted operational progress, receipt-less verified credit, stale review labels, malformed-row censoring, replay inflation, N/R crash avoidance by sample exclusion, or unequal routing semantics.

selection_bias_control.rule: Use intention-to-treat assigned-workload analysis and report accepted verified receipts, accepted operational evidence, duplicate/reject/malformed outcomes, N/R safety outcomes, defer/timeout, verified closures, coverage and assignment-to-closure latency under identical failure/censoring semantics.
